feature_contract.goal: Prevent latency-amplifying synchronous per-spike disk logging on the DX9Ex Present path while retaining complete worst-frame workload, stereo routing, and spike evidence under Reset and diagnostics enable/disable.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: R32 diagnostic-only Present/Reset sampling; no world/eye geometry, HUD, input, FFB, DX11 or DXVK changes.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: Before patch each >=30ms hard spike bypassed its 100ms logging cooldown, calling spdlog::warn on the render thread without limit. Coalescing eliminates per-spike I/O, preserving exact peak in the existing five-second summary. Quest3 FPS effect unmeasured.
trace_stages: R32 draw producer counts game-side draw/primitive/alpha workload before Present.
R32FinalizeFramePerf samples source-frame QPC and current stereo routes, saves the worst window frame.
R32LogPerfWindow emits one five-second summary with worst-frame snapshot and spike count; disable and Reset isolate measurement epochs.
subcomponents: Store accurate worst-frame Present duration, baseline, draw types and stereo route in a bounded zero-allocation window.
Eliminate synchronous per-spike logging, preserving one five-second summary and spike total.
Reset diagnostic window on enable/disable boundaries; integrate negative mutations and randomized load model into full Win32 gate.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: No per-spike synchronous logging; one periodic report with the exact worst-frame detail during any hard spike storm.
Reset and disabled sessions never combine timing windows; all spike count, peak duration and stereo workload values survive.
Destructive source/model checks, exact-SHA game/host/package DX9Ex Active, Domain Isolation and Full Source Impact succeed.

diagnosis.original_evidence: R32FinalizeFramePerf calls spdlog::warn on each hard spike regardless of cooldown, injecting unbounded synchronous logging into game Present.
diagnosis.root_cause: Frame-spike diagnostics generate synchronous logging on the same latency-sensitive thread being measured.
source_trace: D3D9 draw and effect workload counters
R32FinalizeFramePerf QPC and worst frame accounting
R32LogPerfWindow periodic console and disk report
alternatives_rejected: Just increasing a warning cooldown still incurs synchronous disk I/O inside spike bursts.
Dropping peak context would destroy attribution of user-reported 300ms transitions.
Lowering render resolution to mask stalls sacrifices visual quality.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Aggregate worst source frame, baseline, workload, and stereo route at zero extra GPU cost with one five-second log.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Eight destructive mutant checks and seeded 2600-frame burst model wired to exact-SHA Win32 CI.

performance_evidence: Source-confirmed removal of every synchronous per-hard-spike warning; HMD p95/p99 performance gains remain unmeasured.
